Name: Crab Pots Against Trash
Author: stardemod
Description:
This mod reduces the chance of catching trash while fishing if there are Crab Pots nearby. 

The mod works by checking for Crab Pots on the current map and increasing the likelihood of catching actual fish instead of trash. The more Crab Pots are nearby, the higher the chance of avoiding trash. It seems like all the trash was collected by the Crab Pots.

This mechanic tries to incentivizes players to use Crab Pots, making fishing more rewarding.
